title: 第十四章  已经晚了
content_zh:
“依依，要不我请你吃顿饭吧，就当做是上次的赔罪，你看好吗？”王艺依然不依不挠，他觉得现在苏林依不理他就是因为上次他破坏了她买药丸的事。

    “王艺，我跟你再收一次，我要去上课去了，如果没事的话，还请你让开，不要挡着我跟小诗的路！”苏林依皱了皱眉，有点不耐烦的说道，她真的搞不懂，王艺没事做吗，整天游手好闲，自己一睁开眼，第一个来烦他的就是王艺。

    再次被苏林依拒绝，王艺的脸上也有点挂不住了，嘴角抽了抽，不过为了在苏林依面前保持风度，王艺依然努力的保持着微笑，但从旁观的角度去看，这微笑难免显得有些勉强。想了想，还好自己早有准备，立刻从衣服口袋中掏出了一条晶钻项链，这晶钻呈现出的颜色为淡蓝色，而挂着晶钻的链条从材质上看应该是纯铂金的，如果算价值，这条看起来并不大的项链，价值绝对有着十多万。

    一下拿出十多万，只为了博美女一笑，恐怕也就只有王艺这种富家子弟才能做出这样的事情。

    “依依，既然你这么着急要去上早自习，我也不继续跟着你了。”王艺轻柔的将这条晶钻项链递给苏林依，殷勤的笑道：“这是我昨天在宁华市珠宝城特意购买来的蓝钻项链，虽然这颗蓝钻没有那么大，不过却刚好配你的气质，依依，我的一番好意，你千万不要拒绝啊。”王艺说完后，在他旁边的狗腿子贾小亮同样迎合着，道：“苏林依，我们家少爷为了这条项链可是跑了好多地方，少爷他为了你可是真的用心了啊。”

    苏林依叹了口气，这条蓝钻虽然价值确实不菲，不过苏林依却一点不感兴趣，但苏林依不感兴趣，不代表孙依诗不感兴趣，见到王艺竟然拿出了蓝钻，直接想伸出手想要拿王艺手上的项链。

    “哇，我还是第一次见到蓝钻，王艺你还真是给力，这么稀有的钻石你都能买到。”孙依诗自然是故意吹捧王艺的，在她看来王艺就是个傻X，就算被自己坑了，估计还能高兴半天。

    果然听到孙依诗的夸奖，王艺的整个人都飘了起来。

    不过孙依诗刚准备伸出手，拿那颗蓝钻的时候，蓝钻却是被陈木给劫走了，原因就是这颗蓝钻上做了手脚，在陈木看去，这蓝钻上镶嵌了一个微型的摄像头，基本上没人能察觉，陈木之所以可以察觉也是他用神识才能发现，普通人根本发现不了。

    “王少爷，我们家小姐已经说了，你的项链她不要，还请你收走。”既然陈木决定保护苏林依，那自然一切对苏林依有危害的事物，陈木都不会让这些事物接近苏林依。

    眼见自己本来快要成功的计划，竟然被一个陌生的男子给搅乱了，不过一看到陈木的这张脸，王艺更是火冒三丈，这不就是昨天贾小亮说的那人吗？王艺已经肯定，昨天自己甩了狗吃屎，绝对跟眼前的人有关系，经过昨天他的调查，这穿的土不垃圾的家伙，竟然以前还是陈家的种，不过现在已经被赶出了陈家。

    看到陈木的表现，王艺以为陈木想跟他争苏林依，这是王艺绝对无法容忍的，别说陈木现在不过是个被家族扔掉的弃子，就是真是陈家的人，王艺也有一争的实力。

    “呵，原来是你，昨天的事别以为我不知道就是你做的，小子，你以为我不知道你的底细吗，你糊弄的了依依，还能瞒得了我？你以前是陈家的人不错，不过你现在不过是一条被陈家丢出来的一条狗，你还想打苏林依的主意，也不照照镜子，看看你是一副什么德行！”王艺的计划被陈木捣乱掉，对陈木当真是恨之入骨，各种难听的话不绝于耳。让苏林依对王艺的印象再次跌倒了谷底。

    不过陈木听到王艺的骂声，也不管他，只当王艺在放屁，直接站在苏林依的身后，好整以暇，只要王艺不对苏林依做出过分的事情来，陈木根本不想跟他说废话。

    “小诗，我们走吧。”苏林依这次直接快步绕过王艺走掉了，本来王艺还想缠着苏林依，不过却被陈木挡在了中间，王艺现在已经被陈木判定为对苏林依有威胁的人之一，所以陈木不会让王艺接近苏林依半步。

    见到苏林依走远了，王艺脸色阴沉的看着还在跟前的陈木，他有点搞不懂了，区区一个弃少，哪来的勇气阻挡他，难道是不怕死的愣头青？

    王艺今天自然不会轻易放过陈木，这家伙连续坑了自己两次，如果自己还放过他，他就是不是王艺了。实际上王艺不知道的是，陈木已经坑了他三气，包括那次卖药丸，只不过那次陈木用真气将脸部全部包裹住，普通人事后根本无法想起他的样子。

    “小子，你有种，我们去天台？敢不敢？”王艺对着陈木恶狠狠的说道。

    说着王艺也不管陈木去不去，直接先一步走了、

    陈木正准备去出手教训一番王艺，让他以后离苏林依远点，不过却被一个人给拉住了

    “陈木，你不能过去！王艺不是我们能招惹的起的！”陈木回头一看，发现拉住他的人是余北，虽然好久没有见到余北，但陈木还是记得余北的，余北算是陈木在宁华大学最好的朋友，从谢德少问自己要钱的时候就可以看出，余北十分讲义气。

    “没事，他不敢把我怎么样，况且我也不怕他。”陈木笑着对余北说道，他说的自然是实话，可是余北听完，却当成了陈木因为不知道王艺的厉害，所以认为王艺不敢将他怎么样。

    余北可是听说过，以前有一个学生因为走路不小心撞了王艺，结果被王艺打成了重伤，住院好几个月，之后伤好了，根本不敢再来学校了。

    “陈木，王艺真的不是我们能惹得起的，你以前是陈家的人，他自然不敢将你怎么样，你现在已经脱离了陈家，咱们还是能忍就忍，反正只要我们不招惹他，他也不会特意找我们的麻烦。”余北说道，余北不过是一个普通人家出生，对于王艺这种恶少，自然是有些惧怕的。

    “恐怕已经晚了。”陈木摇了摇头，将刚刚的情况跟余北说了一番

    余北叹息了一声，他知道肯定要被挨顿打了，不然跑得了和尚跑不了庙，他可是没勇气直接逃课不上大学，那他的父母知道后，估计会伤心死。

    “既然如此，那我跟你一起去吧，大不了我们兄弟俩一起挨顿揍。”余北咬了咬牙说道。
content_en:
"Yiyi, how about I treat you to a meal as an apology for last time? What do you think?" Wang Yi remained unyielding. He felt that Su Linyi was ignoring him now because he ruined her purchase of pills last time.
"Wang Yi, let me tell you one more time. I have to go to class. If it's okay, please get out of the way and don't block the way of me and Xiao Shi!" Su Linyi frowned and said a little impatiently. She really didn't understand. Did Wang Yi have nothing to do? He was just idle all day. When he opened his eyes, the first person to bother him was Wang Yi.
Being rejected by Su Linyi again, Wang Yi's face became a little uneasy, and the corners of his mouth twitched. However, in order to maintain his grace in front of Su Linyi, Wang Yi still tried hard to maintain a smile, but from the perspective of a bystander, this smile inevitably seemed a bit forced.After thinking about it, fortunately, I was prepared. I immediately took out a crystal diamond necklace from my pocket. The color of this crystal diamond was light blue, and the chain hanging the crystal diamond should be made of pure platinum from the material point of view. In terms of value, this seemingly small necklace is definitely worth more than 100,000.
Spending more than 100,000 yuan at once, just to make a beautiful woman smile, I am afraid that only a rich kid like Wang Yi can do such a thing.
"Yiyi, since you are so anxious to go to morning self-study, I won't continue to follow you." Wang Yi gently handed the crystal diamond necklace to Su Linyi, and smiled attentively: "This is the blue diamond necklace I specially bought at the Ninghua Jewelry City yesterday. Although this blue diamond is not that big, it is justIt matches your temperament well, Yiyi, please don't refuse my kindness." After Wang Yi finished speaking, Jia Xiaoliang, the loser next to him, also catered to her, saying: "Su Linyi, our young master has traveled a lot for this necklace.He is really working hard for you."
Su Linyi sighed. Although this blue diamond was indeed valuable, Su Linyi was not interested at all. But Su Linyi was not interested, which did not mean that Sun Yishi was not interested. Seeing Wang Yi actually taking out the blue diamond, she wanted to reach out and take the necklace in Wang Yi's hand.
"Wow, this is the first time I have seen a blue diamond. Wang Yi, you are really awesome. You can buy such a rare diamond." Naturally, Sun Yishi deliberately praised Wang Yi. In her opinion, Wang Yi was a fool. Even if she was tricked, she would probably be happy for a long time.
Sure enough, Wang Yi's whole body lifted up when he heard Sun Yishi's compliment.
But when Sun Yishi was about to reach out and take the blue diamond, the blue diamond was snatched away by Chen Mu. The reason was that the blue diamond had been tampered with. From Chen Mu's perspective, the blue diamond was embedded with a miniature camera. Basically no one could detect it. The reason why Chen Mu could detect it was that he could only detect it with his spiritual consciousness. Ordinary people could not detect it at all.
"Master Wang, our lady has already said that she doesn't want your necklace, so please take it away." Since Chen Mu has decided to protect Su Linyi, naturally Chen Mu will not let anything that is harmful to Su Linyi come close to Su Linyi.
Seeing that his plan that was about to succeed was actually disrupted by a strange man, but when he saw Chen Mu's face, Wang Yi became even more furious. Isn't this the person Jia Xiaoliang was talking about yesterday?Wang Yi is already sure that the fact that he ditched the dog yesterday must have something to do with the person in front of him. After his investigation yesterday, he found that this guy who was dressed in rubbish clothes was actually a member of the Chen family before, but now he has been kicked out of the Chen family.
Seeing Chen Mu's performance, Wang Yi thought that Chen Mu wanted to compete with him for Su Linyi, which Wang Yi would never tolerate. Not to mention that Chen Mu was just an abandoned son who was abandoned by the family. Even if he was really a member of the Chen family, Wang Yi had the strength to compete.
"Oh, it turns out to be you. Don't think that I don't know what you did yesterday. Boy, do you think I don't know your details? You fooled Yiyi, but you can also hide it from me? You used to be a member of the Chen family, but now you are just a member of the Chen family.You're a dog thrown out by the Chen family, and you still want to take advantage of Su Linyi, but you don't even look in the mirror to see what kind of character you are!" Wang Yi's plan was ruined by Chen Mu, and he really hated Chen Mu, and kept saying all kinds of unpleasant things.Su Linyi's impression of Wang Yi hit rock bottom again.
However, when Chen Mu heard Wang Yi's scolding, he didn't care about him. He just thought Wang Yi was farting and stood directly behind Su Linyi so that he could relax. As long as Wang Yi didn't do anything excessive to Su Linyi, Chen Mu didn't want to talk nonsense to him at all.
"Xiao Shi, let's go." Su Linyi walked quickly around Wang Yi this time. Originally, Wang Yi wanted to pester Su Linyi, but was blocked by Chen Mu. Wang Yi has now been judged by Chen Mu as one of the people who poses a threat to Su Linyi, so Chen Mu will not let Wang Yi get even half a step closer to Su Linyi.
Seeing Su Linyi walking away, Wang Yi looked at Chen Mu who was still in front of him with a gloomy face. He was a little confused. How could a mere abandoned young man have the courage to stop him? Could it be that he was a stupid young man who was not afraid of death?
Wang Yi would naturally not let Chen Mu off easily today. This guy had tricked him twice in a row. If he still let him off, he would no longer be Wang Yi.In fact, what Wang Yi didn't know was that Chen Mu had tricked him three times, including that time when he sold pills. However, that time Chen Mu used his true energy to completely wrap his face, so ordinary people couldn't remember his appearance afterwards.
"Boy, if you have the guts, let's go to the rooftop? Do you dare?" Wang Yi said fiercely to Chen Mu.
After saying that, Wang Yi didn't care whether Chen Mu was going or not, he just left first.
Chen Mu was about to teach Wang Yi a lesson and tell him to stay away from Su Linyi in the future, but he was pulled back by someone.
"Chen Mu, you can't go there! Wang Yi is not something we can offend!" Chen Mu looked back and found that the person holding him was Yu Bei. Although he hadn't seen Yu Bei for a long time, Chen Mu still remembered Yu Bei. Yu Bei was Chen Mu's best friend at Ninghua University. It could be seen from when Xie Des asked him for money that Yu Bei was very loyal.
"It's okay, he doesn't dare to do anything to me, and besides, I'm not afraid of him." Chen Mu said to Yu Bei with a smile. What he said was of course the truth, but after Yu Bei heard it, he thought that Chen Mu didn't know how powerful Wang Yi was, so he thought Wang Yi didn't dare to do anything to him.
Yu Bei had heard that a student accidentally bumped into Wang Yi while walking, and was seriously injured by Wang Yi. He was hospitalized for several months. After the injury healed, he did not dare to come to school again.
"Chen Mu, Wang Yi is really not something we can afford to offend. You used to be from the Chen family, so naturally he wouldn't dare to do anything to you. Now that you have left the Chen family, we can tolerate it as long as we can. Anyway, as long as we don't provoke him, he won't go out of his way to cause trouble for us." Yu Bei said, Yu Bei was just born into an ordinary family, so he was naturally a little afraid of a bad boy like Wang Yi.
"I'm afraid it's too late." Chen Mu shook his head and told Yu Bei about the situation just now.
Yu Bei sighed. He knew that he would definitely be beaten, otherwise the monk would not be able to escape from the temple. But he did not have the courage to skip classes and not go to college. His parents would probably die of heartbreak when they found out.
"In that case, then I'll go with you. At worst, we two brothers will get beaten together." Yu Bei gritted his teeth and said.
